title: AblePath M7 debris-presence evidence record (V2 candidate input contract)
description: Evidence-level record for the per-building boolean debris_present consumed by the frozen M7 residual-width core. debris_present is PRESENCE, not EXTENT: the Moya extent relation D = 0.31h + 1.10 remains the frozen M7 core and is never used to decide presence. A validating record is a well-formed EVIDENCE RECORD only.

damage_state_evidence_id.description: Identity of the damage-state evidence record this presence record is conditioned on (m7_damage_state_evidence_v2).

source_sha256.description: null only permitted while debris_evidence_kind is UNKNOWN.

conditional_on_damage_state.description: The damage state the probability or realization is conditioned on. A collapsed building does NOT automatically imply debris reaching the road (cf. Moya P[D=0|h] = 1.5 e^(-0.43 h)).

probability_of_presence.description: Conditional probability of debris presence. It can never become a boolean through an arbitrary threshold.

realization_seed.description: Required (non-null) for EXPERIMENTAL_STOCHASTIC_REALIZATION; an unseeded realization is rejected.

observed_debris_present.description: null unless debris_evidence_kind is OBSERVED or OFFICIAL_ASSET_LEVEL_SCENARIO.

extent_model_id.description: Identity of the frozen M7 core extent model (Moya). Recorded for traceability only; extent is NEVER used as presence.

extent_variant.description: Frozen M7 core variant name. Recorded for traceability only; never used as presence.

mapping_to_m7_core.description: The core boolean debris_present, or null when no core mapping is asserted. There is no unknown -> false fallback. Note the frozen core rejects damage_state=DAMAGED together with debris_present=true.

x-ablepath.presence_is_not_extent: debris_present is a boolean presence flag. The Moya extent relation (D = 0.31h + 1.10, sigma = 1.11) and its variants mean_case / sensitivity_high_case remain the frozen M7 core and are recorded here only as extent_model_id / extent_variant. Extent is never used to decide presence.

m7_eligibility.OBSERVED: eligible after an accepted observed boolean with source/revision/sha256
m7_eligibility.OFFICIAL_ASSET_LEVEL_SCENARIO: eligible after an accepted official building-level boolean
m7_eligibility.CONDITIONAL_PROBABILITY: never directly eligible; a probability is not a boolean
m7_eligibility.EXPERIMENTAL_STOCHASTIC_REALIZATION: not production eligible until human-frozen via m7_scenario_realization_v1
m7_eligibility.UNKNOWN: never eligible; UNKNOWN stays UNKNOWN and never becomes false

prohibited_derivations: debris extent (Moya D) used as the presence boolean
collapse assumed to imply debris reaching the road
conditional probability converted to a boolean by an arbitrary threshold
unseeded or scenario-less stochastic realization promoted to M7 input
records missing source_id / revision_id / source_sha256 promoted to M7 input
presence asserted without a linked damage_state_evidence_id
alteration of the frozen Moya extent equations in the M7 core
core_mapping_allowed_from: debris_evidence_kind=EXPERIMENTAL_STOCHASTIC_REALIZATION only after a human freeze recorded in schemas/m7_scenario_realization_v1.schema.json (human_freeze_id non-null)
validator_additional_checks: probability_of_presence in [0,1] and never thresholded into mapping_to_m7_core
observed_debris_present is null unless debris_evidence_kind is OBSERVED or OFFICIAL_ASSET_LEVEL_SCENARIO
source_sha256 matches ^[0-9a-f]{64}$ when non-null; null only for debris_evidence_kind=UNKNOWN
Moya Eq.7 must be verified against the original paper before any conditional model is encoded
